decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'Baby Doll'. Source D1S1, D2S1, and D3S3 explicitly identify Elia Kazan as the director of the film 'Baby Doll' (based on Tennessee Williams' work). Source D4S1 identifies Franco Giraldi as the director of the film 'La bambolona', which is internationally released as 'Baby Doll' (and 'Big Baby Doll'). Since both are valid directors of films bearing the title 'Baby Doll' (one being the primary English-language film and the other an Italian film with an international release title), both answers are retained as distinct valid referents.
